UpstreamIntegrationStatus.title: UpstreamIntegrationStatus
UpstreamIntegrationStatus.description:
Connection state of the configured upstream market-data service.

The state vocabulary is deliberately explicit so that the dashboard can
distinguish *not configured* from *configured but never verified* from
*verified reachable* and from *authentication failed*.

VersionDetails.title: VersionDetails
VersionDetails.description:
Version payload extended with the operating mode.

The operating mode is always `research-simulation`; it is surfaced so that
an operator can confirm at a glance that the deployment cannot trade.
